svg.title: Implemented source-normal sampling fold
svg.desc: In the local planar-normal approximation the common RGB source inset is u=s+D(s). Its derivative is negative at the outer edge and crosses zero at 3.89423 dp. This is the Android engineering map, not a native or physical thickness measurement.

g.text: Implemented source-normal coordinate: u(s) = s + D(s)
Local planar normal approximation; common RGB sample before dispersion.
u'(0) = -1.08; fold at s = 3.89423 dp; minimum u = 5.69712 dp
outer normal coordinate reverses until the fold
output inset s from carrier edge, dp
